conviction_note: The one thing this release can add is a full-year forecast decision. JAE only revises at H1, has cut there in 2 of the last 3 years (FY24 and FY26, the second taking it limit-down) and has not pre-released anything. Its own Q1 put H1 operating profit at 9% of plan, while IFIS consensus still sits 25% above the company's plan. That leans negative. Against it: Simplex keeps absorbing selling (14.87% and still buying), FX and gold have moved the company's way since Q1, and the dividend is covered by a stated 3-year payout. Measurement b is p_up 41 on abs_move_pct 5.0, so -0.9 scaled. The findings sum to -0.5. They differ because the scaled number carries the limit-down tail from last year's H1 cut, and the findings net out the floor that the Simplex bid gives.
bar: H1 (Apr-Sep) operating profit against IFIS consensus of 4,020m yen (as of 2026-07-28, Monex/IFIS https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/6807_20260729_act_20260729_153016_2). The company H1 plan is 3,800m yen OP / 3,500m yen ordinary (Q1 短信 https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260728501311.pdf). FY ordinary consensus is 10,588m yen against the company's 8,500m yen (IFIS via kabuyoho, 2026-10-27, https://kabuyoho.jp/reportAnalyst?bcode=6807). The FY OP consensus is 10,676m yen against the company's 9,500m yen. My H1 OP estimate is about 3.0bn yen (Q1 327m plus a seasonal Q2 of 2.5-3.0bn). That estimate is inference, so print_vs_bar is a hypothesis.
positioning_check: JPX short register: 0.0% disclosed, unchanged (as of 2026-10-27, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 0.60 (margin short 50.6k shares against long 30.4k on 10/23, kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=6807). Both sides are trivial next to ~360k shares/day of turnover, so there is no squeeze fuel. The ownership structure matters more: Kyocera holds 33.0% under a disposal standstill (2025-10-30 alliance notice), and Simplex Asset Management holds 14.87%, rising from 5.3% in April and still adding through 10/16. No option skew exists. The run-up is +3.68% over 20 days and -1.52% over 5. The stock is down 10% from the 10/9 high of 2,933.

findings.finding: This release is the one point in the year at which JAE revises its forecast, and the setup points to a cut. Its revision record (kabuyoho/IFIS) shows changes only at the H1 print: FY24 OP cut 18.5->14.0bn on 2023-10-27, FY25 held on 2024-10-23, FY26 cut 18.5->10.0bn on 2025-10-30. There have been no upward revisions and nothing pre-released. Q1 FY27 OP was 327m yen against an H1 plan of 3,800m and an FY plan of 9,500m: 9.9% H1 ordinary progress against a 5-year average of 38.9%. No revision had been filed on TDnet as of the morning of 10/28. Any FY number at or below plan still lands under IFIS consensus of 10,676m OP / 10,588m ordinary.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-30 (H1, FY cut 18.5->10.0bn against ~15bn consensus): next session -17.81%, limit-down (kabutan/Fisco https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6807&b=n202510310535). 2026-04-24 (new-year guide ~10bn below consensus, dividend cut): -2.17%. 2026-07-29 (Q1 miss, guide held): -2.52%. The stock has fallen after each of the last seven prints.
findings.why_not_priced: If the market fully expected a cut, IFIS consensus would sit at or below the company's 8.5bn ordinary. It sits at 10.6bn, 25% above plan, and has fallen only 3.6% in four weeks. The stock trades at PER 29.7 on the company's own EPS of 89 yen, which is not the valuation of a name priced for a further cut. Against that, the consensus target price of 2,383 sits 10% below spot, and GS is at Sell (TP 2,100 on 10/19), so part of the buy side is positioned for it. That is why this is sized well below last year's -17.8%.
findings.independence: Same company-level data family as finding 2 (Q1 短信), but a different claim: the decision on the forecast, not the quarter. Independent support: GS downgrade to Sell, putting FY OP at 9.0bn, 28% under consensus (Fisco 2026-06-09, https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6807&b=n202606090667). The Q1 短信 says the cost measures contribute only 'from the latter half' (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260729/140120260728501311.pdf).

findings.finding: The H1 cumulative operating profit will very likely miss both the 3.8bn plan and the 4.02bn IFIS H1 consensus. Q1 was 327m at a 0.6% margin, hit by gold and copper, energy, procurement costs from the weak yen and labour. Applying last year's Q1->Q2 margin step (+2.7pt) gives a Q2 near 2-3bn.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 missed IFIS by 77% at the ordinary line: -2.52% next session. FY26 Q4 missed by 25%: -2.17%. Q3 FY26 OP miss: -3.63%.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. Anyone can compute the 9.9% progress rate from the Q1 短信, and kabutan published it the same day. What remains is the size of the Q2 shortfall against a stale July consensus of 3.18bn OP for Q2.
findings.independence: Shares the Q1 短信 with finding 1. Monex/IFIS table: https://scouter.monex.co.jp/news/detail/6807_20260729_act_20260729_153016_2

findings.finding: Simplex Asset Management has raised its stake from 5.3% (April) through 10.90% (7/10), 11.68% (7/30) and 13.77% to 14.87% (obligation date 10/16, filed 10/23). It kept buying after the weak Q1. Kyocera holds 33.0% under a standstill on disposals. Together they lock up roughly 48% of the voting rights, and a buyer that has dipped in on weakness for six months is in the stock.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After the -2.52% on the Q1 print (7/30), the stock fell further to 2,378 on 7/31 and then rose to 2,933 by 10/9 while Simplex went from 11.68% to 14.87%. There is no prior print with this holder at this size.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the August-October rally is the visible effect. The part that is not priced is how the print plays out. Last year's -17.8% came with NEC as a seller and no such buyer; a holder still accumulating at 14.87% caps how far a guidance cut can push the price in one session.
findings.independence: Major-shareholder notice from the company itself, 2026-07-21 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260721/140120260721596816.pdf). Kyocera 33.0% and the disposal standstill are in the 2025-10-30 alliance notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251030/140120251030582554.pdf).

findings.finding: Inputs have moved the company's way since Q1. The FY plan assumes 153 yen/$, while Q1 ran at 160 and USD/JPY is ~158 now. Gold, the main plating cost, peaked at $5,434 on 2026-01-29 and traded at ~$4,081 in late June and $4,244-4,666 in August. That supports a held H2 guide rather than a cut.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No clean precedent. The weak yen in Q1 did not prevent a 0.6% margin, because the company says it also raised domestic procurement costs.
findings.why_not_priced: This is a macro-to-company proxy: the company has not quantified its FX or gold sensitivity. A consensus above plan probably already embeds the FX part, so it may be held by the bar rather than unpriced. It is sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Gold path: Farms.com weekly update for the week ending 2026-08-28 (https://www.farms.com/markets/commodity/gold-commodity-update-for-the-week-ending-aug-28-2026), snippet_only. FX from the Q1 短信 commentary (160 yen range).

findings.finding: The downside risk to the dividend is contained. The April 2026 mid-term plan commits to a payout of 30% or more and about 12bn yen of dividends over FY26-28 (~59 yen/share a year on 67.4m shares). The 50 yen FY27 plan therefore survives a profit cut, and a second 減配 at this print is unlikely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-04-24 dividend cut (60->50) was cited as a cause of that day's -2.17% (Fisco https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=6807&b=n202604270270).
findings.why_not_priced: It only removes a tail that a holder fearing a repeat of April might price in. It is small because the policy is public.

outside_window.finding: Simplex at 14.87% alongside Kyocera at 33.0% raises the question of an eventual Kyocera buyout or a Simplex engagement campaign. No document dates any such event inside the window.

Returns: H1 dividend of 25 yen is planned; the payout policy and 3-year 12bn total make a cut unlikely; the Kyocera agreement restricts share issuance and treasury-share disposal, so a buyback is unlikely. baseline_tension: The negative lean mildly agrees with the small negative priced_lean (-0.07) and cuts against the +3.7% 20-day run-up. The strongest positive this release could carry is a held FY forecast, which the company did at H1 in FY25, with the yen weaker than plan and gold off its peak. I looked for it and filed it at +0.5. Add the Simplex bid and the protected dividend, and the net lean is small despite the record of seven negative reactions in a row.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a 進捗率 anyone can compute from the last 短信): the H1 quarter-miss finding goes from -0.8 to -0.3, and p_up moves from 38 to 41. The forecast-cut finding stays at -2.0, because rule 1 exempts a release likely to ADD a forecast cut, and that is exactly its claim.
Rule 2 (check the sign, look for the strongest positive): I had already searched for and filed a held forecast with FX and gold, the Simplex bid and the dividend, so nothing further moved.
